expectation: Membrane ring (MHC class I) on essentially all nucleated cells, stronger on immune and stromal cells, with a honeycomb outline of epithelium. It should be reduced on some tumour cells. Endothelium lining vessels should be positive too.
observed: A: signal follows the tissue and is strongest in the villi, with background glow on the slide outside it. B and C: crisp membrane honeycomb outlines on epithelium, with nuclei dim blue inside the rings. D: out-of-focus haze, uninformative. E1: membrane rings, with brighter cells and a smear near a bright blob. E3: HLAA green overlaps CD31 magenta only partly.
why: B and C show sharp membrane-localised outlines of individual epithelial cells, as an HLAA stain should, even though D and the slide background are hazy.
notes: B and C show crisp membrane rings on epithelial cells, and E1 shows ring-shaped cells. Background glow and the hazy D panel are artefacts, but the membrane pattern is cellular and compartment-correct.
